cases.question: ¿Cuánto sumaron el debe y el haber de los asientos registrados en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) AS total_debe, COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS total_haber FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-04-01' LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el saldo neto por cuenta contable en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT aa.code, aa.name, SUM(jed.debit) - SUM(jed.credit) AS saldo FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN accounting_account aa ON aa.id = jed.account_id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY aa.id, aa.code, aa.name ORDER BY aa.code LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT aa.code AS cuenta, aa.name AS nombre_cuenta, COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS saldo_neto FROM public.journal_entry AS je JOIN public.journal_entry_detail AS jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN public.accounting_account AS aa ON jed.account_id = aa.id WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date <= CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY aa.code, aa.name ORDER BY cuenta LIMIT 50
